One message. Three simple steps.

You are investigating a fictional campus message. Take your time.

  1. Inspect: read the situation, then click the sender or link to reveal its address. You can decide whenever you are ready.
  2. Decide: select your confidence, then choose the action you would take. Your choice is saved immediately.
  3. Explain: read the key evidence and reasoning, then continue to the next case.

Hints and practice settings are available below your investigation. Use Experiments to compare interfaces and My notebook to review progress or try new cases.

All messages and .example addresses are fictional. No message is sent and no credential is requested.
